cases.name: complete_ok
cases.note: The baseline request. Also captures the outgoing upstream payload, which pins the request shape: two messages, top-level reasoning_effort, and no "stop" field.

messages.content: Continue the Pascal program. Output only the new code.

cases.name: complete_no_goal
cases.note: An empty goal must not emit a "{  }" comment line before the prefix.

cases.name: complete_multiline_goal
cases.note: A goal is flattened to one line: newlines become spaces so the goal stays a single Pascal comment.

cases.name: complete_fenced
cases.note: A markdown fence anywhere in the reply is unwrapped, and prose before it is dropped rather than landing in the buffer.

cases.name: complete_parts
cases.note: message.content may be a list of {type,text} parts, not just a string.

cases.name: complete_empty
cases.note: A whitespace-only completion yields "completions": [], never [""].

cases.name: complete_controls
cases.note: C0 controls and DEL are stripped; \t and \n survive.

cases.name: complete_special_token
cases.note: Everything from the first "<|" marker onward is discarded.

cases.name: complete_many_lines
cases.note: An 80-line completion is truncated to --max-lines (30).

cases.name: complete_many_chars
cases.note: A 9000-character single line is truncated to 8192 characters.

cases.name: strip_echo_exact
cases.note: strip_echo pass 1: the reply restates the buffer tail verbatim, an overlap well over the 5-character floor, so the overlap is removed.

cases.name: strip_echo_short_overlap_kept
cases.note: A short overlap is structurally required repetition, not an echo. Two nested blocks legitimately close back to back; stripping "END;" here was a real bug once, so a <= 5 character overlap must be preserved.

cases.name: strip_echo_partial_identifier
cases.note: strip_echo pass 2: the buffer stops mid-identifier ("DISPO") and the reply opens with the whole word, so only the typed prefix is removed.

cases.name: cursor_clamped_beyond_end
cases.note: A cursor past the end of the buffer is clamped, not rejected: it is a normal race between typing and requesting, not a client error.

cases.name: cursor_first_position
cases.note: A cursor at the very start yields an empty prefix.

cases.name: upstream_no_choices
cases.note: Upstream returning an empty choices list must surface as a clean 502, never a stack trace or a 200 with junk in it.

body.error: upstream response was not a JSON object

cases.name: upstream_not_an_object
cases.note: Upstream returning a JSON array where an object was expected must surface as a clean 502, never a stack trace or a 200 with junk in it.

body.error: upstream choice had no message.content field

cases.name: upstream_null_content
cases.note: Upstream returning a null message.content must surface as a clean 502, never a stack trace or a 200 with junk in it.

cases.name: upstream_http_500
cases.note: Upstream returning a non-200 status from the backend must surface as a clean 502, never a stack trace or a 200 with junk in it.

cases.name: upstream_malformed
cases.note: Upstream returning a body that is not JSON at all must surface as a clean 502, never a stack trace or a 200 with junk in it.

body.error: upstream spent its whole token budget on hidden reasoning and never answered; increase max_tokens or check reasoning_effort

cases.name: upstream_reasoning_exhausted
cases.note: finish_reason "length" with empty content but non-empty reasoning_content is an error, not an empty completion. This is what makes --reasoning-effort auto calibration able to tell "this effort value never answers" from "the backend is down".

cases.name: upstream_timeout
cases.note: The backend stalls past --upstream-timeout, so the proxy gives up first and reports it, rather than leaving the editor to time out with no explanation.

cases.name: health_ok
cases.note: GET /health performs a live probe and reports the resolved model and reasoning_effort.

cases.name: unknown_get_path
cases.note: Any GET that is not /health is a 404.

cases.name: unknown_post_path
cases.note: Any POST that is not /complete is a 404.

cases.name: get_on_complete
cases.note: GET /complete is a 404, not a 405: the GET handler only knows /health.

cases.name: empty_body
cases.note: A zero-length body is a 413, not a 400. Surprising, but the size gate runs before any parsing and rejects "<= 0" along with "too large".

cases.name: missing_content_length
cases.note: A missing Content-Length reads as zero and takes the same 413 path.

cases.name: bad_content_length
cases.note: A non-numeric Content-Length is a 400.

cases.name: body_too_large
cases.note: A body over twice --buffer-limit is refused by size before parsing.

cases.name: truncated_body
cases.note: Content-Length promises more than the client sends, then the socket closes: the short read is reported rather than hanging.

cases.name: invalid_json
cases.note: A body that is not JSON is a 400.

cases.name: invalid_utf8
cases.note: A body that is not valid UTF-8 is a 400, not a 500.

body.error: request body must be a JSON object

cases.name: schema_not_an_object
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a JSON array as the whole body with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_buffer_missing
cases.note: Schema validation rejects no "buffer" key at all with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_buffer_not_string
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a non-string "buffer" with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_goal_not_string
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a non-string "goal" with a 400 naming the offending field.

body.error: "cursor" must be an object with line/column

cases.name: schema_cursor_missing
cases.note: Schema validation rejects no "cursor" object with a 400 naming the offending field.

body.error: "cursor" must be an object with line/column

cases.name: schema_cursor_not_object
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a non-object "cursor" with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_line_zero
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a line number below 1 (the protocol is 1-based) with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_line_bool
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a boolean line -- rejected even though bool is an int subtype with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: schema_column_bool
cases.note: Schema validation rejects a boolean column, likewise with a 400 naming the offending field.

cases.name: buffer_over_limit
cases.note: A buffer over --buffer-limit but under the raw byte gate is rejected by schema validation, with the limit named in the message.

cases.name: health_upstream_unreachable
cases.note: A backend that is not listening is reported as 503 with an error message, not a hang or a traceback.

cases.name: calibrate_settles_on_none
cases.note: Only reasoning_effort='none' answers; every other candidate reports budget exhaustion. The proxy must try none, low, medium, high, omitted in that order and settle on the one that works.

cases.name: calibrate_settles_on_medium
cases.note: Only reasoning_effort='medium' answers; every other candidate reports budget exhaustion. The proxy must try none, low, medium, high, omitted in that order and settle on the one that works.

cases.name: calibrate_settles_on_omitted
cases.note: Only reasoning_effort='' answers; every other candidate reports budget exhaustion. The proxy must try none, low, medium, high, omitted in that order and settle on the one that works.
